name: cavemio-number-roll
title: Number Roll
description: Numbers that move with their value. Each changing digit rolls into place, with support for currency, compact notation, and live counters.

cavemio.accessibility: The full formatted value is available as real text to screen readers. Decorative digit columns are hidden. Tabular figures keep the digits aligned; reduced motion disables digit rolling.
cavemio.previewNote: Demo values are local; no network requests.

useCases.title: Pricing pages
useCases.description: Animate a price when the billing period or plan changes.

useCases.title: Live dashboards
useCases.description: Keep changing metrics readable as new data arrives.

useCases.title: Landing page stats
useCases.description: Roll a number from an initial value when the component mounts.

useCases.title: Countdowns and timers
useCases.description: Use a fixed downward direction for decreasing values.

features.title: Digits follow the value
features.description: Each column rolls in the direction the number moves.

features.title: Room for another digit
features.description: New places expand into the number and removed places fold away.

features.title: Formatting built in
features.description: Pass Intl.NumberFormat options for currency, percentages and compact values.

features.title: Real text underneath
features.description: Assistive technology and copy-and-paste receive the formatted value.

states.title: Rolling
states.description: Changed digits roll to their next value; unchanged places stay still.

states.title: Growing
states.description: Additional digit places open when the value grows.

states.title: Shrinking
states.description: Places no longer needed collapse from the number.

states.title: Initial count-up
states.description: Supply from to animate from a starting number after mount.

props.name: format
props.description: Currency, percent, decimals, compact notation or grouping.

props.name: locales
props.description: Locale used to format the number.

props.name: prefix / suffix
props.description: Text placed before or after the formatted number.

props.name: from
props.description: Optional starting value for the initial count-up.

props.name: direction
props.description: Override the direction inferred from value changes.
